facts.title: Southwestern Kale Power Salad with Sweet Potato, Quinoa & Avocado Sauce
ingredients: 1 bunch kale, ribs removed and chopped into very small, bite-sized pieces
2 medium sweet potatoes (about 1 ½ pounds), sliced into small, ¼-inch cubes
2 ripe avocados, sliced into long strips
1 medium jalapeño, deseeded, membranes removed and roughly chopped
¼ teaspoon fine salt, to taste
1 can (14 ounces) black beans, rinsed and drained, or 1 ½ cups cooked black beans
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
